instructions.original_snippets: NEVER use spaces instead of tabs for recipe indentation
instructions.content: Never accept space-indented recipe lines; GNU Make requires a hard tab, and spaces produce a confusing 'missing separator' error.
Never leave a non-file target out of .PHONY; if a same-named file exists, Make silently treats the target as already up to date.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER use bare $(shell ...) calls in recipe variables without quoting
instructions.content: Never flag an unquoted $(VAR) expansion inside rm, sudo, or curl as safe; it enables command injection exactly like an unquoted shell variable.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER use recursive make with a bare make command
instructions.content: Never accept a bare make -C call inside a recipe; it drops the parent's jobserver flags and can break parallel builds. Use $(MAKE) instead.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER export all variables globally with .EXPORT_ALL_VARIABLES
instructions.content: Never treat .EXPORT_ALL_VARIABLES as harmless; it exports every variable in scope, including secrets loaded from .env files, to every sub-process.

instructions.original_snippets: Syntax: GNU make -n --dry-run validation; catches errors with line numbers
instructions.content: Run GNU make's own -n dry-run to catch dependency-graph and syntax errors with line numbers.

instructions.original_snippets: Formatting: mbake tab indentation, variable assignment consistency, trailing whitespace, line continuations
instructions.content: Check formatting consistency: tab indentation, variable assignment style, trailing whitespace, line continuations.

instructions.original_snippets: Best practices: .DELETE_ON_ERROR, .PHONY declarations, $(MAKE) for recursive calls, .ONESHELL error handling
instructions.content: Check for .DELETE_ON_ERROR, complete .PHONY coverage, $(MAKE) for recursion, and .ONESHELL where multi-step recipes need shared shell state.

instructions.original_snippets: Security: hardcoded credentials, unsafe variable expansion, command injection, .EXPORT_ALL_VARIABLES leakage
instructions.content: Scan for hardcoded credentials, unsafe variable expansion in dangerous commands, and .EXPORT_ALL_VARIABLES leakage.

instructions.original_snippets: mbake doesn't recognize some valid GNU Make special targets -- the validator filters these false positives
instructions.content: Filter known mbake false positives (.DELETE_ON_ERROR, .SUFFIXES, .ONESHELL, .POSIX) rather than reporting them as errors.

instructions.original_snippets: Exit codes: 0 no issues, 1 warnings, 2 errors
instructions.content: Map validation results to exit codes 0 (clean), 1 (warnings), 2 (errors) for CI/CD integration.

instructions.original_snippets: For each finding, report the location, the risk, and the fix
instructions.content: Report every finding as a concrete line reference, the risk it creates, and the specific fix -- not just that an issue exists.
